blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will be picked up from your hotel and driven across the border into Argentina.

The crossing follows the Tancredo Neves Bridge over the Iguazu River. After crossing the border, continue through the natural park on the Argentine side.

The Argentine side offers a different perspective on the falls. Here, the paths run closer to individual cascades and, in places, bring you almost directly above the falling water.

You will see the source of the Devil's Throat and walk through the natural park around the falls.

The main difference today is how close you get to the water. While the Brazilian side offers a broad view of the entire front of the falls, the Argentine side lets you approach individual torrents and feel their force at close range.

Return to your hotel after the tour.
